content: Grand Theft Auto 6 may be the highest-rated game of all time on Metacritic, and may have earned a record-breaking $3.79 billion on launch day, but that doesn't mean Rockstar Games' new blockbuster can't have its haters. Multiple groups have descended on GTA 6 's Metacritic page to attack the game for its perceived shortcomings, much of that criticism is based on culture war nonsense.
